places.name: Old Town Porvoo (Wooden Houses)
places.ai_summary: A charming historic district with colorful wooden houses, cobblestone streets, and a rich cultural heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Capture photos of the iconic red riverside warehouses.

places.name: Porvoo Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A medieval cathedral with stunning architecture, offering a glimpse into Porvoo's religious and cultural history.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and services.

places.place_tip: Admire the intricate wooden carvings inside the cathedral.

places.name: Porvoo Riverside Warehouses
places.ai_summary: Iconic red-painted warehouses along the Porvoo River, a symbol of the city's trading history and charm.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset for picturesque views.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a riverside walk and take in the serene atmosphere.

places.name: Brunberg Chocolate Factory
places.ai_summary: A delightful chocolate factory offering tours and tastings, perfect for indulging your sweet tooth.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal variations in opening hours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to buy some handmade chocolates as souvenirs.

places.name: Porvoo Museum & Town Hall
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing Porvoo's history and culture, located in the charming old town hall building.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on the first Friday of every month.

places.place_tip: Explore the exhibitions on Porvoo's medieval history.

places.name: Jokiranta Riverside Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic riverside walk offering beautiful views of the Porvoo River and the old town.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Look out for local wildlife along the riverbank.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful garden designed by Runeberg himself.

places.name: Holm House Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum in a well-preserved wooden house, offering insights into Porvoo's bourgeoisie history.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in Finnish and Swedish.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful garden and the historic interiors.

places.name: Näsinmäki Hill Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint offering panoramic views of Porvoo, the river, and the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the breathtaking scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for cruise times and availability.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can be windy on the water.

places.name: Linnamäki Fortress Hill
places.ai_summary: A historical site with the ruins of a medieval fortress, offering insights into Porvoo's past.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for safety.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes, the terrain can be uneven.
